name: A11Y-230 — CommentBubble other-timestamp ink repair (textSubtle→textMuted on surfaceNeutral), a11y-qa 2026-07-31 Phase B. Disposes the ship-ready comment-report proof set's 'SHIPPED timestamp (THE FINDING)' rows.
_doc: PURPOSE: prove the replacement ink clears WCAG AA 4.5 (normal text) on the other-person bubble fill in BOTH themes. The old pair — textSubtle #707070 on #eef1f5 (light) / #8a8a8a on #323237 (dark) — measured 4.37 / 3.69 and was recorded-but-never-disposed by shipready-comment-report-stacks.json.

SCOPE: the pairing is CommentBubble-only (Phase A lens-4 blast-radius + Phase B sibling grep: chips on surfaceNeutral ink with color.text, not textSubtle). The OWN-bubble timestamp is textOnBrand on ctaFill — covered by a11yqa-brand-ink-stacks.json.
Timestamp is AT-hidden (composite label speaks it) — this is visual-only 1.4.3.
